name: Своды и факелы
style: VAULTS AND TORCHES: wood-faced tabs nest inside shallow segmental stone arches, visibly separated rough gray masonry blocks and one keystone. Both side panels are dungeon alcoves with stone pillars and a pair of small iron torch sconces fixed to their outer jambs. Main CTA is a wood plaque across a descending-stair doorway motif. Tiny amber flames only, no surrounding bloom. Cool chalky gray stone, warm dry walnut, muted red active marker. Arches must dominate frame silhouettes.
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE fully illustrated 16:9 intoDeDung hub screen. Reference gives layout and scene, NOT the new frame design. Redesign the UI with immediately recognizable DUNGEON ATTRIBUTES built into BUTTON SHAPES, PANEL FRAMES and selection markers. Make these details conspicuous at menu scale, not tiny background props. Keep MATTE WOOD covering most of every button face, diffuse dry shading, restrained grain; no lacquer, glossy bevels, gold trim, jewels or bloom. Use dull iron/stone accents and muted brick red selection; no yellow/gold selected-card border. Clear cream lettering, dark ink on parchment. Preserve four top tabs, resource line, three squad cards left, fortress courtyard with three heroes center, preparation panel right, main action bottom-right. Retain the reference sunset courtyard. Large readable labels, uncluttered interiors, small functional icons. Info rows are flat text, not raised buttons. Exact labels: 'Поход', 'Наёмники', 'Кузнец', 'Колода'; 'Золото 100', 'Эссенция 0'; 'Отряд', 'Воин', 'Щитоносец', 'Лучница', 'Дополнительно'; 'Подготовка', '7 комнат', 'Отряд: 3', 'Колода: 10 карт', 'Готово', 'В путь'. No extra cards/tabs, no collage, no outside captions, no watermark. VARIANT: VAULTS AND TORCHES: wood-faced tabs nest inside shallow segmental stone arches, visibly separated rough gray masonry blocks and one keystone. Both side panels are dungeon alcoves with stone pillars and a pair of small iron torch sconces fixed to their outer jambs. Main CTA is a wood plaque across a descending-stair doorway motif. Tiny amber flames only, no surrounding bloom. Cool chalky gray stone, warm dry walnut, muted red active marker. Arches must dominate frame silhouettes.
